Load required packages
```{r,load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```
Read in data
```{r}
Dev <- read.csv("TDO 072023/TDO2 DevTime.csv")
#Key <- read.csv("TDO 072023/TDO2pupation.csv")
Key <- read.csv("TDO 072023/TDO2pupationtest.csv")
```


```{r}
Key2<-Key%>%select("Vial","Group","EggPicker","Npupae","DateStarted","TimeStarted","Geno","Color","Treatment","TDOConc","DMSO.")
Dev<-merge(Key2,Dev,by="Vial")
```


```{r}
Dev$Start<-paste(Dev$DateStarted,Dev$TimeStarted)
Dev$Start <- as.POSIXct(Dev$Start, format = "%m/%d/%Y %I:%M %p")

Dev$Collected<-paste(Dev$Date,Dev$Time)
Dev$Collected <- as.POSIXct(Dev$Collected, format = "%m/%d/%Y %I:%M %p")
```


```{r}
# Calculate the time passed in hours
Dev$Hours <- as.numeric(difftime(with(Dev, Collected), 
                                            with(Dev, Start), 
                                            units = "hours"))
```


```{r}
DevTime<-Dev %>%select("Vial","Hours","Male","Female")
DevTime$Hours<-as.factor(DevTime$Hours)

# Function to add missing rows for each Vial with missing Hours and set Male and Female to zero
add_missing_rows <- function(dataframe) {
  all_hours <- unique(dataframe$Hours)  # Get all unique Hours levels in the dataframe
  all_vials <- unique(dataframe$Vial)   # Get all unique Vials in the dataframe

  # Create a template dataframe with all combinations of Vial and Hours
  template_df <- expand.grid(Vial = all_vials, Hours = all_hours)
  
  # Merge the template dataframe with the original dataframe to add missing rows
  new_df <- merge(template_df, dataframe, all.x = TRUE)
  
  # Replace NA values in Male and Female columns with zero
  new_df$Male <- replace_na(new_df$Male, 0)
  new_df$Female <- replace_na(new_df$Female, 0)
  
  return(new_df)
}

# Add missing rows for each Vial with missing Hours and set Male and Female to zero
DevTime2 <- add_missing_rows(DevTime)

DevTime2M<-DevTime2%>%select("Vial","Hours","Male")
DevTime2M<-DevTime2M%>%rename("N"="Male")
DevTime2M$Sex<-"Male"

# Calculate the cumulative sum of the 'Value' column for each Vial
DevTime2M <- DevTime2M %>%
  group_by(Vial) %>%
  mutate(CumulativeSum = cumsum(N))

DevTime2F<-DevTime2%>%select("Vial","Hours","Female")
DevTime2F<-DevTime2F%>%rename("N"="Female")
DevTime2F$Sex<-"Female"

# Calculate the cumulative sum of the 'Value' column for each Vial
DevTime2F <- DevTime2F %>%
  group_by(Vial) %>%
  mutate(CumulativeSum = cumsum(N))

DevTime<-rbind(DevTime2M,DevTime2F)

DevTime2<-merge(Key2,DevTime,by="Vial")
```

```{r}
DevTime2$Remaining<-DevTime2$Npupae-DevTime2$CumulativeSum

Key%>%group_by(Color) %>%
summarise(
    Color = Color,
    Totalpupae = sum(Npupae, na.rm = TRUE))->TotalP
TotalP<-distinct(TotalP)

DevTime2<-merge(DevTime2,TotalP,by="Color")
```


```{r}
write.csv(DevTime2, "TDO 072023/TDO2 DevTime2.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
